methodology.technique: Public posts are collected per account and replies and reposts are discarded. Within each account, the median engagement of the posts in a bucket is compared against the median engagement of that same account's posts outside it, producing one ratio per account. The reported effect is the median of those per-account ratios, with a distribution-free 95% interval around it. Account size therefore cancels out instead of being re-measured, and the unit of evidence is the account rather than the post, because posts inside one account are not independent observations of how the platform behaves.
methodology.effectDefinition: An effect of +10% means the typical measured account earned 10% more engagement on posts in that bucket than on its own posts outside it. The interval beside it is a 95% confidence interval on that figure; where the interval spans zero the page reports no measurable difference rather than a small effect. It is not a click-through rate and not a guarantee for any individual account.

uncertainty.method: Distribution-free 95% interval over the per-account multiples, computed by the ingestion engine. Reported on every finding as effectLoPct and effectHiPct.

significanceRule.description: A finding is marked significant only when its 95% interval stays entirely on one side of zero AND at least 30 independent accounts contributed a comparison. Everything else is reported as no measurable difference rather than as a small effect.

uncertainty.unitOfEvidence: accounts, not posts. Posts within one account are not independent observations of how X behaves, so `accounts` is the evidence count and `n` is descriptive scale only.
uncertainty.spreadNote: medianMultiple and p90Multiple describe the spread of the underlying distribution across accounts. They are not the confidence interval; that is effectLoPct to effectHiPct.

notes: Effects are observational associations across accounts, not causal estimates. No controlled experiment was run.
The thread dimension is omitted: the classifier currently identifies almost no posts as part of a thread, so any thread figure would be an artefact rather than a finding.
The language dimension is omitted: the language mix of this catalog reflects which accounts are tracked, not how X treats languages, so a per-language effect would be a fact about our sampling.
Interaction counts are read at collection time and reflect that moment. They are not live figures and will differ from what the platform shows today.
Related account-level reports are published under https://playersells.com/insights/{handle} for every account with a stable sample.
